predictions: Another just solid week, hitting almost exactly on my overall average for the season. 18-7 last week, and I lost THREE of my seven wrong were in tiebreakers (and two more ended on the last 501). I even predicted that one of those would go to a tiebreaker, but I just tabbed the wrong team as the winner. So close, so often. That brings me to 177-72 (71.1%) for the season, with B and D divisions (only 60% right each) as my problem children. At least I got a For Kids pick correct…

Match of the week: (E Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Liquor Possee. It's not quite a direct head-to-head for the E title, but it's pretty close. With the Possee one ahead in the loss column, they can really take hold of this race with a victory, but if Dart Side wins, this becomes a full-on point race (since they're only one point apart heading into this one). Let's make some drama… Dart Side takes the final 501, 13-11.

Match #2: (G Div.) Killer Dee's @ That's What She Said. She Said has been on a perfect roll this season… except when facing the Dee's! Dee's thumped them last time around, and are still just barely within reach in this title chase (although the multiple mail-in penalties have really dunked the point race chances). Let's take Dee's again! 13-11.

Match #3: (F Div.) Zero Dart Ton 80 @ Sofa Kings. It is becoming a done deal that Zero Dart will take the F crown this spring, but the race for 2nd is super duper alive and well. And all three of the competitors in that race for #2 still have to go up against Zero Dart again. How they do there could be a big factor in the final standings. Zero Dart, 14-10.

Match #4: (C Div.) The Outlaws @ Hump Day! Hump Day got the massive win last week to move to the top of the C standings. But the next step in that title path is to avoid a post-win letdown against the only team in C that hits more ASPs than they do (and that's without Shane Murray back in the fold). Danger week here… Hump, 13-11 again.

Match #5: (B Div.) Put It on Matt's Tab @ Inconsistently Consistent. With Stumble dropping three of their last four, it all of a sudden looks like the race for 2nd in B has a wide open array of contestants. Stumble does still hold the point lead though, so a decent win streak will be needed to pass them. Let's go with… (In)Consistent, I guess? 13-11.

Match #6: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Off Constantly-Reboot. With McGavin getting run over last week, Off Constantly now fully controls their own title hopes again. Win out and they win, simple as that. That starts with a close win here, in the only second half pairing that is the first time teams have gotten together. OC, 13-11.

Match #7: (D Div.) Reload @ Ton 80 Proof. Despite their loss to the Idiots last week, Reload can still take the D title by just winning out (since they have quite a point lead still). Ton 80 is a dangerous opponent, regardless of their current bottom-two spot. Reload, 15-9.

Matches #8 & #9: (B Div.) Double In, Stumble Out @ One Armed Bandits; Nine Lives @ Trips Are For Kids. With Stumble's recent troubles, 2nd-8th in B are separated by a total of only 3 wins and 24 points. Are both the race for 2nd AND the race to avoid the bottom-two finishes kinda wide open now? Yeah, sorta looks like it. I think Stumble rebounds, 14-10; and I'm still taking the Kids, 13-11.

Matches #10 & #11: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Duck Around & Find Out; Runs with Corks @ Bangin The Wire. The Ducks have won 3 of their last 4, and now who will finish in the bottom-two in E is very much in question. Are the Cheapies and Corkers far enough ahead of tonight's opponents to avoid a drop to the bottom-two? Maybe, but I think they both escape. Cheap, 13-11; Corks, 14-10.
Match #12: (G Div.) The Neighborhood Dart Knights @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Yep, this match might determine who ends up in a bottom-two finish in G. A little crazy, no? Knights, 15-9.
